# Treat as

**Not a comparable commerce ERP.** Decentralized VMS conglomerate (Harris, Jonas, Volaris, Perseus, Topicus, Vela, …). Corporate AI is ambassadors, coding upskill, M&A lens — **no CSI-wide customer agent product**. Mark Miller (Q4 2025): no material new AI revenue yet. Bender (AGM 2026): agentic AI vs seat-based pricing is a cannibalization risk.

# AI surface (named, not CSI-wide)

ClickDimensions AI Workforce (Tim/Clara/Lexi); Celcat AI; **K2B INFINIA** (Jonas): intent-based NL **navigation** on a modular ERP, with purchase-request/recon agents as next version; club/fitness/collections copilots; Harris Govern researching AI with human oversight; Cayenta copilots still hiring; Perseus Everest 3.0 is **internal**.
